title: Tensor with the evaluated ordered Tate line translates finite Tor bounds
statement: Fix a finite-field datum $D$, a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(D.k)$ and finite $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $T$ be Noetherian separated finite type over $D.k$. Use a prescribed system tensor calculus $b$ [det-sp-tower-shriek-levels] and actual strict Tate towers $w$ [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. For $d,n\ge0$, put $R_n=\mathcal O_E/\ell^{n+1}$ and let $L_d$ be the ordered d-fold tensor of the positive Tate tower shifted by two, with $L_0$ the coefficient unit [def-sp-chart-tate-tower-data, def-sp-tower-class-systems]. Let $M\in D(T_{\mathrm{proet}},R_n)$ be bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers] with specified Tor interval $[a,z]$ [def-weil-proetale-tor-amplitude]. Then $M\otimes^L (L_d)_n$, using the given finite-level tensor, has constructible cohomology in all degrees and Tor amplitude $[a-2d,z-2d]$. No scheme morphism, tower lift of M, normalization, or global tower bounds are assumed.

proof.text: Evaluate L_d recursively using the tensorEvaluation isomorphism. Evaluation of the coefficient unit gives the finite coefficient unit at d=0. Evaluation commutes with the shift by two and with the single functor in each successor factor. The given w.level comparison identifies the degree-zero factor with the actual positive ell-power Tate line.

The ideal equality ell^(n+1)=varpi^(e(n+1)) identifies the finite coefficient line with the positive uniformizer-level Tate line. It is locally free of rank one. On a trivializing cover, tensoring with it is the identity, so it is exact, preserves constructibility, and preserves every specified Tor interval; transport through the coefficient comparison.

For every degree-zero test module use derived tensor associativity and the shift formula H^i(C[2])=H^(i+2)(C). Thus a successor factor subtracts two from both Tor endpoints; constructibility shifts to the corresponding degree. Induct on d, reassociating tensor and transporting along the evaluation comparisons, to obtain [a-2d,z-2d]. The unit case, first coefficient level, coincident endpoints and zero complexes are included.

theorem ordered_line_level_bounds
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) [CharP D.k D.p] (hne : l ≠ D.p)
    (T : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian T] [T.Over (Spec (.of D.k))]
    [IsSeparated (T ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (T ↘ Spec (.of D.k))] [QuasiCompact (T ↘ Spec (.of D.k))]
    (w : SpChartAdmissibility.Twists l E T) (d n : ℕ)
    (M : proEtaleDerivedCategory T (SpTowerShriek.R l E n))
    (hM : spFiniteConstructibleTor T (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) M)
    (a z : ℤ)
    (hTor : HasProEtaleTorAmplitude T (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) M a z) :
    let N := ((b.calculus T).levelClosed n).tensor.obj
      (M, (SpTowerShriek.Ev l E T n).obj (SpTowerGamma.orderedLine l E b T w d))
    (∀ i : ℤ, IsConstructibleProEtaleModuleSheaf T (SpTowerShriek.R l E n)
      ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
        (proEtaleRingModules T (proEtaleConstantRing T (SpTowerShriek.R l E n))) i).obj N)) ∧
      HasProEtaleTorAmplitude T (SpTowerShriek.R l E n) N
        (a - 2 * d) (z - 2 * d)
